features.name: initial_hr
features.description: Mean of raw HR samples in trial seconds [0,10).

features.name: prior_hr_slope
features.description: Linear slope fitted to those same ten samples.

features.name: energy
features.description: Published Spotify descriptor; not waveform RMS.

features.name: loudness
features.description: Published Spotify loudness; not playback volume or waveform dBFS.

features.name: accousticness
features.description: Source column spelling is intentional: accousticness.

input_format: CSV; all ten columns required; audio NaNs use stored training medians; HR state must be finite and initial_hr positive

target.time_origin: first available trial HR sample, not verified music onset

recommended_use: offline recorded-example demonstration and benchmark; audio has not improved held-out prediction over HR state alone

simulator_compatibility.song_ids: Spotify track IDs here; Jamendo song IDs in simulator library. No automatic cross-catalog mapping.
